✨Paintball Wars✨
- Compete against the enemy team across a variety of game modes & maps!
- Work your way up to obtain the best specialists & weapons so you may dominate the battlefield!
- Wipe the enemy with style through unlocking awesome weapon skin cosmetics that make your presence known!

👑 ROBLOX PLUS BENEFITS
- Claim "Premium Noob" specialist for free!

❤️Thank you for your support so far!❤️

👍Don't forget to leave a thumbs up!👍

⚠️Lots of aspects of this game are still WIP & we're keen to receive feedback to help us improve every users experience.⚠️

📣Follow social links for updates & free in-game prizes!📣
